Rule: All rows in the candidate input pool.
Exclude the source stratum whose reference values are estimated rather than measured.
Exclude the source stratum containing case or already compensated values.
Require finite measurements, Ear > 25 C, 35 < core reference < 42 C, -40 < ambient < 60 C, and hour in [0, 24].
After source and numeric QC, retain animals with at least eight eligible records.
